attribution.note: Both cited pages state that no writer or calligrapher is recorded.
attribution.noteZh: 两处所引页面均记此碑无撰书人姓名。

compositionDate.note: 后碑刻于建宁元年（168）四月，与前碑同石。

background: An Eastern Han stele of 169 recording the chancellor Shi Chen’s sacrifices at the Confucius Temple, with a second inscription on the reverse dated 168. Held in the Qufu Han–Wei Stele Gallery.

review.note: Draft work record added in the 2026-11 corpus expansion from an institutional page. Not independently reviewed; aliases and script classification are not source-audited.
